log.msg: DECISION - the day rail and the compose box BOTH moved to /framework/ai/log/. The front now answers one question (where is the thing I asked for) in one screen; starting work is a working action and belongs on the working surface, which is the full log, named in one line under the wall. Nothing was deleted.

DECISION - /framework/ai/log/ is a route() branch in ai/page.js, like effort/, not a log/ dir with its own page.js. The day route above it is a REGEX on the same segment, so a declared child would have to be kept out of its way forever; log can never look like a date. Fewer files, day route untouched.

FINDING - 2026-08-13/panel has only session.json, no task.jsonl. Creating one would have BROKEN that card: manifest() prefers task.jsonl and returns it the moment it loads, so the session.json outcome, state and links would all vanish. Marked 2026-08-16/panel-swiss-army instead - the task where ext/Panel became the direct-manipulation tool.

45 highlights appended through ai-highlights-mark.mjs (scratchpad), JSON.stringify only, pure ASCII, fs.appendFileSync; every line of all 45 files re-parsed after the append - 0 bad lines, 45/45 assembled back to exactly what was written. Six icons, one per kind: layers=a framework tier, explore=a place, science=a study, article=a post, build=a tool, straighten=a standard.

THE 45 MARKED, flip any of them by deleting its highlight line. 08-14 browser-cli-bridge Ask from the browser; 08-14 dev-toolbar The dev rail; 08-14 jsonl The task log format; 08-14 layout-tool DesignTool; 08-15 doc-system The docs system; 08-16 browse-grids The layouts wall; 08-16 ui-wall-masonry The component wall; 08-16 panel-swiss-army Panel; 08-17 screenshot-tool The screenshot tool; 08-18 research-system The research system; 08-21 ux-system-plan The ux tier; 08-26 page-generator The page generator; 08-26 column-pages Column pages; 08-29 imagine-root The imagine world; 08-29 scenes-3d Scenes in 3D; 08-29 imagine-mag The magazine; 08-29 shells-lab Ten app shells; 08-29 screens-lab Eight full screens; 08-29 game-round-2 The game; 08-30 homepage The front page; 08-30 blog-build The blog; 08-30 post-hello Hello lew42; 08-30 post-panel Panel and Playground; 08-30 color-stacks Color stacks; 08-30 research-system The research program; 08-30 streaming-pages Pages that stream; 08-30 json-pages Pages as data; 09-01 color-study The color inventory; 09-01 controls-study Every control one wall; 09-01 themes-browser The theme browser; 09-04 paging-core The paging system; 09-05 codrops The Codrops demos; 09-05 layout-system Eighteen numbered layouts; 09-06 layout-a core/Layout; 09-06 section-b core/Section; 09-06 notes-pages The notebook; 09-06 doodles Notebook doodles; 09-06 omnibox-search Site search; 09-06 size-standard One size knob; 09-06 ui-theme One box every control; 09-06 platform-slice The platform slice; 09-08 layouts-standard The layouts encyclopedia; 09-08 websites-db The websites corpus; 09-08 patterns What the web does; 09-08 blog-playwright Playwright explained.

LEAST SURE of these three: 08-14 jsonl (the log FORMAT is infrastructure, not a place to visit); 09-06 doodles (twenty-three drawings, lovely but small beside the notebook itself); 08-30 json-pages (a lab inside the cms realm rather than a realm of its own). Deleting any highlight line removes its card and nothing else.

BRIEF CHANGED by the owner, relayed 11:12 - the wall is now GROUPED BY DAY (newest day first, a small day heading over each group linking to /framework/ai/<date>/) and renders the most recent 100 by default, not ~24 on one screen. 100 is a cap not a target, so the backfill goes beyond 30-50: anything the owner would go and open later. Applying both; the one-screen-at-1920 tuning (WALL 20, the shrunk intro title) is superseded by the 100 cap, but the title trim stays - it was 237px of label above the first useful thing.

log.msg: WAVE 2 of the backfill: 36 more highlights, 81 total, all through the same script (idempotent - a task already carrying one is skipped, so a second run cannot double-append). Added: Timeline, the spacing ruler, the editor, the file browser, the elements pages, the Page docs, four ux classes (Auth, Wizard, Course, Tree), feeds, vary, gallery, decks, youtube, blogx, cms, two more blog posts, the demo system, four research subjects, generated pages, eight more design studies, sections, the page builder, the spacing ramps.

PROOF - four widths (400, 1280, 1920, 3440), zero console errors, zero sideways scroll, zero region overflow on all four urls. /framework/ai/ draws 81 highlight cards = exactly the 81 highlight lines appended (no Show more appears: 100 is the cap and 81 is under it). /framework/ai/log/ draws 40 + 1 active, and 80 + 1 after one Show more click. /framework/ai/2026-09-08/ is unchanged at 24 cards, /framework/ai/effort/websites/ unchanged at 16. Shots in this dir: front-, log-, day-, effort- at each width; the numbers are in proof.json.

FIX found while proving - the log board sat in the page main track and every card was 640px of a 1920 screen with its three regions stacked. It needed the same wide word dashboard() already says. After: card 288 at 400, 890 at 1280, 1419 at 1920, 2806 at 3440.

ALL 81 highlight urls loaded headless: 78 clean, 3 with PRE-EXISTING console 404s that are not mine and not in my fence - /imagine/cms/ and /imagine/cms/json/ both fetch /imagine/cms/welcome/page.js (a declared child with no page.js), and /imagine/research/disclosure/ fetches nine such children (aatip-videos, odni-2021, grusch-aaro, legislation and five more). Every one of the three still renders; the 404s are silent console noise for whoever owns those pages.

LEFT DELIBERATELY - (1) the effort board (/framework/ai/effort/<slug>/) is still in the 40em main track like the log board was, so its cards are narrow at 1920; the brief required that page be provably UNCHANGED, so it was measured and left, one word (wide on ai-effort in dashboard.js) from the same fix. (2) rail() still fetches all 572 task.jsonl files to find the 81 with a highlight - unchanged from before, and unavoidable without a second index file, which would be the curated list this design exists to avoid. (3) 2026-08-13/panel keeps only its session.json.

assign.outcome:
**The AI front page is a wall of 81 highlights, grouped by day** — [/framework/ai/](/framework/ai/): what is running, the usage windows, then a card for every thing worth going back to, newest day first. Every task of every day moved to [/framework/ai/log/](/framework/ai/log/), forty at a time.

![](front-1920.jpg)

**A highlight is one line a task appends to its own `task.jsonl`** — `{"assign": {"highlight": {"icon", "title", "line", "url"}}}`. `assign` replays onto the manifest, so it arrives as `m.highlight` with no reader change and nothing to keep in step: the task record stays the one source of truth, and deleting the line removes the card. The card links to **the thing**, never to the task page. Six icons, one per kind: `layers` a framework tier, `explore` a place, `science` a study, `article` a post, `build` a tool, `straighten` a standard.

- New: `ext/AITask/highlights.js`. Changed: `dashboard.js` (the front, `log_board()`, paging), `ai.css`, `ai/page.js` (the `log` route), `page.js` doc registration, `readme.md`, `doc/manifest.md`, one sentence in `.claude/skills/finish-task/SKILL.md` §3.
- **The backfill** — 81 highlights across 22 days, every one appended by a script (`JSON.stringify`, pure ASCII, `fs.appendFileSync`, every line of all 81 files re-parsed after: 0 bad). The full list is in this task's log, one line each, so any of them can be flipped by deleting its line.
- **Proved** at 400 / 1280 / 1920 / 3440: zero console errors, zero sideways scroll, zero region overflow. 81 cards on the front = 81 lines appended. The log draws 40, then 80 after one Show more. [2026-09-08](/framework/ai/2026-09-08/) and [effort/websites](/framework/ai/effort/websites/) unchanged at 24 and 16 cards. Numbers in `proof.json`, shots beside it.
- Found and fixed while proving: the log board sat in the page's 40em `main` track, so every card was 640px of a 1920 screen. It wanted the `wide` word `dashboard()` already says — now 1419px at 1920, 2806px at 3440.

**Left, each for a reason:**
- The effort board is still narrow the same way the log board was — one word from the same fix, but the brief required that page be provably *unchanged*, so it was measured and left.
- `/imagine/cms/`, `/imagine/cms/json/` and `/imagine/research/disclosure/` each console-404 on declared children with no `page.js`. Pre-existing, outside this task's fence, and all three still render — named here so someone who owns them can close it.
